prompts.applies_when: The business claims BCA CRS registration or a CR06 workhead and grade
prompts.question: Does BCA’s directory show the claimed workhead, grade and validity for the same company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Registration is relevant to the work and procurement claims made by the firm.
prompts.manual_reason: Directory uses an interactive company search; registration is not a universal licence for all design work.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company or UEN in BCA e-directory; compare the exact CRS workhead, grade and expiry against the claim.
prompts.found_when: An identified current record explicitly contradicts the advertised workhead, grade or expiry.
prompts.not_found_when: The record matches the entity and the precise current claim.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Search fails, firm identity uncertain, or no listing alone does not establish a legal breach.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: The firm claims an IDCS 2025 I-DEA award
prompts.question: Does the claimed IDCS I-DEA project, category and award tier match the organiser gallery?
prompts.why_it_matters: Correct award attribution protects the accuracy of a portfolio.
prompts.how_to_query: Compare exact project, category, award tier and credited firm with the 2025 gallery and linked project.
prompts.found_when: An official record for the same project contradicts an explicit claim with identity and roles confirmed.
prompts.not_found_when: The gallery confirms the specific award, year and credited firm.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Different year or programme, gallery unavailable, attribution uncertain or project absent.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: A named professional or firm claims IDCS membership
prompts.question: Does the claimed IDCS membership match the relevant individual or firm listed?
prompts.why_it_matters: Individual and firm memberships must not be conflated.

source.name: Interior Design Confederation Singapore members listing

prompts.manual_reason: Membership listing is opt-in and may require interactive search; absence is not a negative result.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the public listing, compare named person or firm and membership type; verify current status with IDCS if unclear.
prompts.found_when: A confirmed record explicitly conflicts with the stated membership.
prompts.not_found_when: The appropriate named member and stated current status are confirmed.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Members may opt out of public listing; an absent name is not proof, and a record may be ambiguous or unavailable.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.
